verdict.line: You lose if you facetank Judgment and Decisive Strike back-to-back and let Garen's Perseverance top him off between trades; you win if you poke with Q and pull out with E before he can lock you down or heal it back.

brief.thesis: This matchup is decided by whether you let Garen sit in extended trades. His Perseverance passive regenerates a percentage of his health every second he isn't hit, so short poke-and-retreat patterns using E (Valor) to step out deny that sustain, while long trades let him out-heal your damage. At 46.5% over 679 games this is close to a coinflip, and the swing point is level 6 when his Demacian Justice execute plus Ignite can end a fight you thought you were winning.

theirWindow.when: level 6+, Ignite up, you're below 50% HP
theirWindow.what: Demacian Justice deals more the lower your health is and Ignite denies any heal-back. Do not stand in a trade below half health once he has ultimate up.

yourWindow.when: his Decisive Strike (Q) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Decisive Strike breaks slows and silences on hit, so it's his answer to being kited. With it down (8s cooldown) he can't punish your Q (Broken Wings) poke or chase you off after E (Valor). Commit your combo in this window.

runes.keystoneWhy: the adaptive damage and healing stacks from repeated hits let you out-sustain his Perseverance regen in longer skirmishes once you're ahead

playing.title: Poke then step out with E
playing.detail: Use E (Valor) to close for a Q hit or two, then reposition away rather than staying in his hitbox. Every second you're not hit is a second closer to his Perseverance ticking again, so short exchanges favor you.

playing.title: Track his Decisive Strike cooldown
playing.detail: Decisive Strike silences on hit and breaks slows, which shuts down your combo and chase. Once he's used it, you have 8 seconds where he can't stop your Q-W-E engage.

playing.title: Respect level 6 with Ignite up
playing.detail: Demacian Justice deals more damage the lower your current health is. Don't trade below 50% HP once he hits level 6 with Ignite available, since that's a kill threshold, not a normal poke exchange.

playing.title: Save E to block Judgment
playing.detail: Valor's forward step blocks incoming damage while active. Time it to absorb his Judgment spin rather than his Q silence, since Judgment is the larger chunk of his trade damage.

playing.title: Bank Runic Blade charges before committing
playing.detail: Your empowered autos from Runic Blade are your real damage in a trade. Don't waste ability casts on wave clear right before an all-in window — you want charges up when you engage.

playing.title: Use Wind Slash to punish disengage
playing.detail: Once R (Blade of the Exile) is active, Wind Slash lets you hit him at range as he tries to walk off and heal via Perseverance. Save it for when he's disengaging low, not as an opener.

brief.patchCaveat: The build path, rune page, boots, and summoner spells above are the measured majority picks from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the trade patterns, cooldown windows, and level-by-level read are our own tactical analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Use your abilities to attack and fall back periodically to prevent Garen from activating his passive ability. Be careful when Garen reaches level 6 and has Ignite.
